name: Ichijou Miori
source:
Rei's older sister.
Despite being fulltime housewife and never having worked before, she is forced to work part-time by her abusive husband in order to make up for his salary cut. 
She respects Hayato as senpai at work because he always helps her and covers the mistakes she makes without looking down on her clumsy and timid behavior.
translation:
Rei's older sister.
Despite being fulltime housewife and never having worked before, she is forced to work part-time by her abusive husband in order to make up for his salary cut. 
She respects Hayato as senpai at work because he always helps her and covers the mistakes she makes without looking down on her clumsy and timid behavior.
